text.p: Brokers expect Chilean stocks to add to their bullish run Friday, though on lower volume than earlier in the week due to the Thursday holiday and a more measured trading pace.
Nonstop rain and localized flooding in Santiago since Wednesday night have ended lingering concerns about the effects of drought in central Chile on electrical shares, brokers said.
But one broker said gains in electrical stock prices will likely be muted by their sharp gains earlier this week.
The blue-chip IPSA index ended Wednesday at 127.16, up 0.71 percent for the day. The all-share IGPA ended at 5562.35, up 0.73 point.
Brokers expect volume to ease off from early in the week because Thursday was the Corpus Christi holiday in Chile and many investors have taken a four-day weekend.
